#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <vector>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;

class TaskB {
public:
    void solve(int testNumber, istream& in, ostream& out) {
        int n;
        in >> n;
        in.ignore(); // ignore newline after reading integer
        string str;
        getline(in, str);
        
        if (n <= 0) {
            out << "0 0";
            return;
        }
        
        string s = str.substr(0, n);
        
        // Tokenize by underscore, parentheses and keep them as tokens
        stringstream ss;
        for (char c : s) {
            if (c == '_' || c == '(' || c == ')') {
                ss << ' ' << c << ' ';
            } else {
                ss << c;
            }
        }
        
        string token;
        bool inside = false;
        int curLen = 0;
        int insideWords = 0;
        int maxLen = 0;
        
        while (ss >> token) {
            if (token == "_" || token == "(" || token == ")") {
                if (curLen > 0) {
                    if (inside) insideWords++;
                    else if (curLen > maxLen) maxLen = curLen;
                    curLen = 0;
                }
                char c = token[0];
                if (c == '(') inside = true;
                else if (c == ')') inside = false;
            } else {
                curLen += token.length();
            }
        }
        
        if (curLen > 0) {
            if (inside) insideWords++;
            else if (curLen > maxLen) maxLen = curLen;
        }
        
        out << maxLen << " " << insideWords;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    
    TaskB solver;
    solver.solve(1, cin, cout);
    cout.flush();
    
    return 0;
}
